comment: Contract vectors: canonical serialization + identity for the Mosaico 'mosaico.pull' v1 source descriptor. Any consumer of the descriptor must reproduce these bytes and identities verbatim. Regenerating requires bumping the descriptor version — a changed byte stream is a different request (cache miss), and a silently regenerated vector would hide that. HISTORY: these vectors were regenerated ONCE when the descriptor moved from the pre-release flat 'mosaico-sequence' shape to the nested 'mosaico.pull' request shape produced by the source-capture pipeline (host:port origin, decimal-ns strings). That regeneration IS the v1 version cut; from here the vectors are frozen. v1 wire rule: request.topics is STRICTLY ASCENDING (production sorts + dedups; the parser rejects any other order rather than re-sorting, so canonical bytes stay unique per request).
